claims.where: Never change what scores you
claims.quote: Removing a line from an instrument, such as the grid's `KNOWN`, a listed mutation, a corpus task or its reference program, a probe, or the record's frame, fails the requirement every score has.

claims.quote: A version improves a score when even its worst run beats the best that any version before it was sure to give.

claims.quote: a [lion-reasoning](../skills/lion-reasoning/SKILL.md) task folder whose scores are the qualities `research/runs/self-improvement/plan.md` measures
